Yes, you are right.
There is a conflict between the default font size in the Note editor, which is 10, and the default font size in the default style. In this case IDS-Normal for the Detailed Ind. Report and the size is 12 there.
The font size from the style takes over, if the size is set to 10 in the Note Editor.
For the font size to keep 10 I must explicit mark the text and set it to 10, otherwise I get font size 12. This is not obvious that you should do this to get the font size shown in the editor.
